summary: Static verification-only audit for the reported Shoonya (Finvasia Noren) OAuth authentication failure. No code was changed. Executed: (1) pnpm --filter @cts/api typecheck -> exit 0; (2) pnpm --filter @cts/api build -> success; (3) node backend/tests/shoonya_oauth_harness.cjs -> 9/9 ALL PASS; (4) node backend/tests/shoonya_callback_context_harness.cjs -> 10/10 ALL PASS; (5) all 17 backend/tests/*.cjs regression harnesses -> ALL GREEN (Fyers, Upstox, Zerodha, instruments, manual trade, follower payload, etc. all pass). Spot-checked shoonya.adapter.ts source: authorize URL is https://api.shoonya.com/OAuthlogin/authorize/oauth with client_id only (line ~141, URLSearchParams({ client_id: this.apiKey })) — no redirect_uri is sent, consistent with Shoonya OAuth SDK/docs where redirect URI is portal-registered and not client-provided. Token exchange goes to /NorenWClientAPI/GenAcsTok with jData={code, checksum}, checksum=SHA256(apiKey+secretCode+code), no Bearer/jKey — matches contract. Authenticated reads use Bearer + jKey on NorenWClientAPI (verified via harness cases getProfile/UserDetails/positions). Callback recovers reconnect context via self-contained state token from query param OR cts_oauth_state HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie (Shoonya does not echo state) — harness explicitly covers 'no state param, cookie carries context' for both User & Master flows, and confirms Fyers/Upstox still use state-param+map (untouched). NO live api.shoonya.com call was made (env forbids and harness monkey-patches axios by design).
action_items: NO application code change required. Root cause is PORTAL-side: the Shoonya Developer Portal 'Redirect URL / Callback URL' registered against the OAuth app must exactly equal the app's live callback endpoint (scheme + host + path + trailing slash). Ask the user to open the Shoonya/Finvasia developer portal for their OAuth app and confirm the registered Redirect URL exactly matches the deployed API's Shoonya callback route (e.g. https://<api-host>/api/brokers/shoonya/callback or /brokers/shoonya/callback — the controller registers both). Any mismatch (http vs https, host, trailing slash, path prefix) will cause Shoonya to reject the authorize step or the code exchange, matching the reported failure while every other broker still works (they each have their own portal-registered redirect URIs and use different OAuth contracts).

Also verify with the user that the Shoonya API Key (client_id) and Secret Code stored in the runtime .env / DB credential row correspond to the SAME OAuth app whose Redirect URL is registered in the portal — mixing apiKey from App-A with the redirect URL registered on App-B produces identical symptoms.
No retest needed on backend code; retest is a live-login step on the user side after portal correction.
critical_code_review_comments: shoonya.adapter.ts getLoginUrl correctly sends only client_id — matches Shoonya support guidance; do NOT add redirect_uri (adding it would break the flow).

GenAcsTok exchange correctly excludes Bearer/jKey and uses SHA256(apiKey+secretCode+code) checksum — verified by harness case 'exchangeToken POSTs GenAcsTok with correct checksum, no Bearer, sets token'.
cts_oauth_state cookie is HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax (Secure in prod) — CSRF posture preserved; fail-safe on tampered cookie verified.

shoonya.controller.ts registers dual routes ['brokers/shoonya','api/brokers/shoonya'] due to main.ts setGlobalPrefix('') — good coverage; ensure the portal-registered redirect matches ONE of these exact paths.
Encrypted daily-token persistence via shoonya.service.saveSession/validatePersistedSession is intact — no regression.
test_credentials: N/A — no live broker/DB/server calls. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not applicable to this OAuth-portal audit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This was a STATIC verification-only audit — no source files were modified. The Shoonya OAuth code contract is confirmed correct against Shoonya SDK/docs and all 17 .cjs harnesses pass. The reported Shoonya login failure is NOT reproducible in code: the app does not control the redirect/callback URL (Shoonya does not accept a client-supplied redirect_uri on the authorize call — the portal-registered value is used). If a future sprint needs to reproduce/fix the live failure, it must be exercised against a real Shoonya OAuth app whose portal Redirect URL is verified to exactly equal the deployed callback route (both /brokers/shoonya/callback and /api/brokers/shoonya/callback are exposed by the controller because main.ts uses setGlobalPrefix('')). Do NOT attempt to add redirect_uri to getLoginUrl — that would break the working contract.
rca of the issue: RCA: Shoonya's OAuth authorize endpoint (https://api.shoonya.com/OAuthlogin/authorize/oauth) accepts ONLY client_id (+ optional state) — the redirect/callback URL is bound server-side to the OAuth app record inside the Shoonya Developer Portal and cannot be overridden by the client. All other brokers in this system (Fyers, Upstox, Zerodha) accept a client-supplied redirect_uri or use different flows, which is why they keep working while Shoonya fails. Application code review + 9/9 shoonya_oauth_harness + 10/10 shoonya_callback_context_harness confirm: (i) authorize URL, (ii) GenAcsTok checksum exchange, (iii) Bearer+jKey reads, (iv) encrypted session persistence, (v) callback context recovery via state param OR cts_oauth_state cookie — are all implemented per Shoonya spec. Therefore the root cause is PORTAL-SIDE configuration: the Redirect URL registered against the Shoonya OAuth app in the developer portal does not exactly match the app's callback endpoint (or the apiKey/secret in runtime env belongs to a different portal app than the one whose Redirect URL is registered). Reproduction (user side, cannot be done here): (1) initiate Shoonya login from the app; (2) observe rejection on Shoonya's hosted page or an error on code exchange. Mitigation (portal only, ZERO code change): (1) log into Shoonya/Finvasia developer portal → open the OAuth app whose client_id/api-key equals SHOONYA_API_KEY (or the DB credential) currently in use; (2) set 'Redirect URL / Callback URL' to EXACTLY one of the app's callback routes — recommended: https://<deployed-api-host>/api/brokers/shoonya/callback (must match scheme, host, path, no trailing slash unless the app emits one); (3) save and re-attempt login. No retest of backend code is required after portal fix; a live login attempt by the user is the verification step.
